book.name: BHAEBHULANIA
book.title: Bhaluwa ja a Pauli ku Bhaebhulania

content: Bhukala a Nnungu bhatendaga bheleketa na ashaambuje yetu, kupitila ashinkulondola bhabho papagwinji na kwa namuna yaigwinji,
ikabheje agano mobha ga kumpelo gano, a Nnungu bhanabheleketa na uwe kupitila Bhanabhabho. Bhubhaabhishile kubha bhalishi bha indu yowe, na kupitila bhenebho bhashipanganya shilambolyo.

Bhenebho ni nnga'nyimo gwa ukonjelo gwa a Nnungu, nnandanyo gwa a Nnungu bhayene, gubhabhishile indu yowe kwa lilobhe lyabho likwete mashili, bhakamaliyeje kwaaleshelelanga bhandunji yambi, gubhatemi kunkono nnilo gwa Bhakulungwa a Nnungu kunnungu.
Mwana ni nkulungwa kupunda ashimalaika, malinga ukulungwa gwa lina lyabho libhapegwilwe na a Nnungu kupunda mena gabhonji.
Pabha a Nnungu bhangannugulila nkali kamo, malaika jwabho jumo,
Wala bhangabheleketa kuka malaika jojowe kuti,
Ikabheje a Nnungu pubhaatumile bhanabhabho, lyelo lyabho bhalinkuti,

content.text: Bhashikwaatendanga ashimalaika bhabho bhatumshi, kubha mbungo na lilamba lya moto.

content: Ikabheje gaka Mwana, a Nnungu bhakuti,

content.text: “Upalume gwenu, mmwe a Nnungu unalonjeya pitipiti!
Mmwe nnaapinga aki na nkaapinga ya ilebho.
Kwa nneyo a Nnungu, a Nnungu bhenu, bhashikumpa ukulungwa kupunda ajenunji,
Kwa kunng'agula kubha a mpalume bha nng'angalo.”
Na kunnungu ni mmwe pemmwe mpengenye.
Nkupinga kwiipindanya mbuti likoti, na ipinga tindiganywa mbuti iwalo.

content: Bhuli apali malaika jubhakunnugulilaga a Nnungu kuti,

content.text: mpaka pushinaabhikanje ashaamagongo ajako pai jako?”

content: Igala ashi malaikabha ni nndi? Bhalabhonji ni ashi mbumu bhakwatumishilanga a Nnungu na bhaatumwanga na bhenebho kwa ligongo lya kwaajangutilanga bhalishi bha ntapulo.
